messages.subject: SC Asset | Sustainable real estate, governance and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear SC Asset Leadership Team,

SC Asset's scale and sustainability focus make the company a strong match for my experience managing ESG, institutional relationships and complex investment stakeholders.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring practical experience aligning public institutions, communities, strategic partners and internal teams around high-value operating and investment priorities. My recent work also includes renewable-energy transition and carbon-data governance.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached an SC Asset-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
